name: claude-code-peer
description: Give Codex and Claude sessions a durable lifecycle and cross-session messaging.

interface.shortDescription: Run and message durable agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Runs explicitly owned Codex and Claude sessions with durable lane lifecycle, local discovery, and bidirectional messaging while ordinary Codex threads remain inactive.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the local Claude Code and Codex peer sessions I can message.
